Actor and comedian Russell Brand joins Tucker Carlson to talk about his baptism, Big Pharma, Donald Trump, and what he calls the globalists' bid to become God. Brand was a wild star who turned to faith and blunt politics in mid life.

Brand tells how cold river water and prayer changed the course of his days. He rails at drug firms and at chiefs who play at being gods with tech and law. Carlson meets him as a fellow foe of the same powers. Listeners get Brand in full flow, funny and grave at once. The library keeps the talk as a record of his turn.

New York Post columnist Miranda Devine joins Tucker Carlson to discuss Joe Biden's secret contempt for Kamala Harris. Devine, author of Laptop from Hell on Hunter Biden, covers the family's scandals closely. Palace intrigue fills this hour, along with the question of Hunter's legal fate.

Devine shares reporting on the cold relationship between Biden and his vice president. She walks through Hunter's cases and whether he will ever face real justice. Carlson asks what the family story says about power in Washington. Political and curious viewers get insider dish from a reporter deep in the beat.
